description: This Java file defines the 'Role' entity class for the application, including its properties, relationships, and accessor methods.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Entity class representing user roles with associated permissions, mapped to the 'roles' table in the database.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the role.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the role.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the set of permissions associated with this role.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets the permissions associated with this role.
